about: True parameters of the notifications extension dataset in data/synthetic/, written by scripts/make_synthetic.py from src/mktstats/synth/. Do not edit by hand.

dgp.description: n_users app users. Engagement theta ~ Normal(0, 1) and fatigue sensitivity kappa = exp(KAPPA_THETA theta + Normal(0, KAPPA_SIGMA)) are hidden; sessions_last_30 ~ Poisson(exp(1 + 0.6 theta)), purchases_last_90 ~ Poisson(exp(-0.3 + 0.5 theta)) and tenure_days are observed, and segment buckets sessions_last_30 (low 0-1, mid 2-4, high 5+). Each day a policy sends one of three templates or skips. Fatigue F_{t+1} = RHO F_t + sent_t. A send is opened with probability expit(OPEN_ALPHA[template] + OPEN_THETA theta - OPEN_FATIGUE F); an open is a session. After a send the user opts out with probability expit(OPTOUT_BASE + OPTOUT_SLOPE kappa F) (F before the send), for good; UNINSTALL_SHARE of opt-outs uninstall and never visit again. Without an open the user visits with probability expit(ORGANIC_BASE + ORGANIC_THETA theta - ORGANIC_DECAY min(days_since_session, 30)); any session resets days_since_session to 0. In a session the user buys with probability expit(BUY_BASE + BUY_THETA theta + BUY_OFFER [offer]); an order is ORDER x GROSS_MARGIN of margin, OFFER_DISCOUNT less when bought from an offer. The same uniforms are drawn every day whatever the policy does (common random numbers across policies at one seed).

steady_state_fatigue.note: F after a long run of sends every k-th day: 1 / (1 - RHO^k) just after a send

send_experiment.definition: mean over eligible user-days of the potential-outcome difference (reminder sent vs skipped) in sessions and margin today, from the same uniforms
